# Storefront Demo

> A neutral, themeable e-commerce storefront built on SellRight (generic commerce API + Qwik frontend). This is a demo instance — catalog, pricing, and copy are placeholders configured per deployment via the theme config (see `src/theme/theme.config.ts`).

## Products

Catalog index: `/shop/`. Individual product pages live at `/products/{slug}/`.

## Site map

- [Homepage](/)
- [Shop](/shop/)
- [Blog](/blog/)
- [Contact](/contact/)
- [Returns](/returns/)
- [Privacy](/privacy/)
- [Terms](/terms/)

## Notes for automated agents

This is a template deployment. Store name, contact details, and social links are configured per-brand via environment variables and are not hardcoded in this file's source.
